nodes.description: Owner address of the handler, used in onlyOwner access control.
Identifier of this token handler within the market.
Reference to the marketManager contract which coordinates handlers and interest.
Reference to the interest model contract used to compute interest deltas.
Reference to the handler data storage contract holding balances and EXR.
Reference to the underlying ERC20 token used for transfers.
Decimal scaling factor for unified token amounts.
Decimal scaling factor for underlying token amounts.
Name of the handled token.
Reference to the savings-interest handler data storage contract.
Constant 10**18 fixed point base used for unified math.
Caller address, used as user address for deposit/withdraw/borrow/repay and reserve deposit.
Block-level dependency (block.number) used for first-action / block delta checks.
External payable deposit entry: applies interest, updates storage, pulls tokens.
External withdraw entry: applies interest, checks limits, decrements deposit and sends tokens.
External borrow entry: applies interest, checks limits, increments borrow and sends tokens.
External payable repay entry: applies interest, decrements borrow and pulls tokens.
External payable reserve deposit that updates reserved/deposit totals and pulls tokens.
Owner-only reserve withdraw that decrements totals and sends tokens to reserve address.
Market-manager-only liquidation that applies interest and adjusts deposit/borrow storage.
Market-manager-only reward payout that decrements delinquent collateral and transfers tokens.
Owner-only circuit breaker toggle.
Market-manager circuit breaker toggle.
Owner-only ownership transfer.
Internal token send to a user with balance-delta verification; performs external ERC20 call.
Internal token pull from a user with balance-delta verification; performs external ERC20 call.
Internal interest application orchestrating new-customer, first-action and interest update.
Internal check that registers a new user and seeds their EXR.
Internal block delta check that syncs action EXR when a new block occurs.
Internal interest update calling the interest model and storage.
Internal computation of total/user amounts with interest deltas applied.
Internal update of signed reserved spread amount.
Internal decimal conversion from unified to underlying token amount.
Internal decimal conversion from underlying to unified token amount.
Fixed point multiply-divide helper using unifiedPoint.
Fixed point divide helper using unifiedPoint.
Owner-only setter for the marketManager address.
Owner-only setter for the interest model address.
Owner-only setter for the handler data storage address.
Owner-only setter for the ERC20 address and token name.
Owner-only setter for the unified decimal scaling factor.
Owner-only setter for the underlying decimal scaling factor.
External view of maximum borrowable amount for a user.
External view of maximum withdrawable amount for a user.
External ERC20 transfer call inside _transfer, potential reentrancy vector.
External ERC20 transferFrom call inside _transferFrom, potential reentrancy vector.
External call into marketManager.applyInterestHandlers which mutates accounting state.
External state mutation on handler data storage (amounts, reserved, EXR).
Raw multiplication/division used in conversions before require-based checks.
Amount parameter used by deposit/withdraw/borrow/repay/reserve flows.
User address parameter accepted by interest and view functions.
Boolean parameter controlling the circuit breaker state.
New owner address parameter for ownership transfer.
Borrower address parameter for liquidation flows.
Liquidator address parameter for liquidation reward flow.
Local computed action amount in withdraw/borrow.
Local user address derived from msg.sender inside deposit.
Boolean flag selecting full interest/reward calculation mode.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to derive the depositing user address in deposit.
msg.sender becomes the withdrawing user address in withdraw.
msg.sender becomes the borrowing user address in borrow.
msg.sender becomes the repaying user address in repay.
msg.sender is the source of reserve deposit tokens in reserveDeposit.
msg.sender supplied user address flows into _transferFrom for token pulling.
erc20Instance is the token contract used by _transfer.
erc20Instance is the token contract used by _transferFrom.
Block-level dependency (block.number) drives first-action/block-delta logic in _checkFirstAction.
owner is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on setCircuitBreakWithOwner.
owner is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on ownershipTransfer.
owner is checked by onlyOwner on setUnifiedTokenDecimal.
owner is checked by onlyOwner on setUnderlyingTokenDecimal.
marketManager instance is used to invoke applyInterestHandlers.
handlerDataStorage instance is the target of external accounting mutations.
unifiedTokenDecimal participates in the multiplication/division of _convertUnifiedToUnderlying.
underlyingTokenDecimal participates in the multiplication/division of _convertUnderlyingToUnified.
unifiedPoint constant is used as divisor in unifiedMul.
deposit invokes _transferFrom which performs an external ERC20 transferFrom.
withdraw invokes _transfer which performs an external ERC20 transfer.
borrow invokes _transfer which performs an external ERC20 transfer.
repay invokes _transferFrom which performs an external ERC20 transferFrom.
reserveDeposit invokes _transferFrom which performs an external ERC20 transferFrom.
reserveWithdraw invokes _transfer which performs an external ERC20 transfer.
partialLiquidationUserReward invokes _transfer which performs an external ERC20 transfer.
deposit calls marketManager.applyInterestHandlers externally.
withdraw calls marketManager.applyInterestHandlers externally.
borrow calls marketManager.applyInterestHandlers externally.
partialLiquidationUser calls marketManager.applyInterestHandlers externally.
deposit mutates handler data storage amounts.
withdraw mutates handler data storage deposit amounts.
repay mutates handler data storage borrow amounts.
partialLiquidationUser mutates handler data storage deposit/borrow amounts.
_transfer executes the external erc20Instance.transfer call.
_transferFrom executes the external erc20Instance.transferFrom call.
_transfer converts unified amount to underlying via _convertUnifiedToUnderlying.
_transferFrom converts unified amount to underlying via _convertUnifiedToUnderlying.
deposit calls _applyInterest when flag is false.
repay calls _applyInterest when flag is false.
partialLiquidationUserReward calls _applyInterest for the delinquent borrower.
_applyInterest first calls _checkNewCustomer.
_applyInterest then calls _checkFirstAction.
_applyInterest returns _updateInterestAmount.
_updateInterestAmount reaches _getAmountWithInterest through _setAmountReflectInterest.
_updateInterestAmount reaches _updateReservedAmount through _setAmountReflectInterest.
_convertUnifiedToUnderlying performs raw mul and div on user controlled amounts.
A malicious ERC20 transfer callback can re-enter withdraw before accounting settles.
A malicious ERC20 transfer callback can re-enter the liquidation reward payout path.
A malicious ERC20 transferFrom callback can re-enter deposit during token pull.
A malicious ERC20 transferFrom callback can re-enter repay during token pull.
The marketManager interest call is an external callback that re-enters handler accounting.

normalization_plan.reason: The user supplied amount parameter only carries value into the deposit entry point.
The user address parameter is consumed directly by the interest application routine.
The boolean circuit breaker parameter flows only into the breaker setter.
The new owner parameter is used solely to update the owner state variable.
The delinquent borrower parameter is consumed only by the liquidation entry.
The liquidator parameter is used only for the reward transfer destination.
The adjusted amount local is computed and used only within the withdraw action.
The local user address is a direct alias of msg.sender inside deposit.
The flag parameter selects the interest application branch of the deposit action.
